In his famous essay \"On Bullshit\", Harry G. Frankfurt argues that a
bullshitter is someone who does not care about the difference between
true or false, but will use whatever comes to hand in order to persuade.
He gives advertising as the clearest example of bullshit. Then, I
accidentally found this:\
